question: Should OpenClaw core support native cross-gateway session messaging now, and if so should it use the linked `gateway.peers` session-tool design or wait for a broader gateway federation contract?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses gateway trust, session-state, message-delivery, and credential boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API or security model.

options.title: Design federation first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define identity, scopes, replay handling, transcript ownership, and transport before merging any implementation.

options.title: Advance the linked PR
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43656 only after conflicts, security review, upgrade behavior, and real multi-gateway proof are resolved.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Document plugin, MCP, or channel workarounds instead if maintainers decide native cross-gateway session routing is outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Design federation first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define identity, scopes, replay handling, transcript ownership, and transport before merging any implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history signal for session-tool routing and security-scoping decisions in the affected path.
